## Exercises

1. Create a new variable that indicates if the major has more women than men



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
more_women_flag <- college_recent_grads %>%
  mutate(more_women = if_else(sharewomen < .5, 0, 1)) %>%
  select(major, major_category, sharewomen, more_women)
```

4. Create a scatterplot of median income vs. proportion of women in that major, colored by whether the major is in a STEM field or not.



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
college_recent_grads %>%
  mutate(STEM = if_else(major_category %in% stem_categories, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sharewomen, y = median, fill = STEM)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", pch = 21, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Stem Major", values = c("#FFA219", "#FECCDD")) +
  labs(
    x = "Proportion of women in major",
    y = "Median income of major"
  )
```

## Exercises

1. Which airline had the most Airbus planes departing NYC in 2013?



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

  left_join(flights, join_by(tailnum)) %>%
```

2. Calculate the average temperature, wind speed, and percipitation by origin airport for the month of January.  Try to do this using `pivot_longer()` and one `summarize()` statement.



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
weather %>% 
  filter(month == 1) %>% 
  select(origin, temp, wind_speed, precip) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=temp:precip, 
               names_to = "weather_type",
               values_to = "weather_data") %>% 
  group_by(origin, weather_type) %>% 
  summarize(avg_weather_data = mean(weather_data, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = weather_type, 
              values_from = avg_weather_data)
```

3. Try to recreate this plot that displays the average wind speed and wind gusts by month on the same plot. (Hint: pivot to get the values Use `geom_line()`



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
weather %>% 
  select(month, wind_speed, wind_gust) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = wind_speed:wind_gust, 
               names_to="wind_type", 
               values_to="mph") %>% 
  group_by(month,wind_type) %>% 
  summarize(mph = mean(mph, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mph, color = wind_type)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  theme_bw()
```
